body.Subject: [EXTERNAL] You have been granted ADMIN access to the '578 EHRM Training App'!
body.Body:
[ DO NOT REPLY - AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED EMAIL ]



Hello @{body('Get_item')?['GivenName_Text']},

You have been approved for ADMIN access to the '578 EHRM Training App' by a manager/admin at the Edward Hines Jr. VA Hospital! Please see the details below regarding the new level of advanced access that you have been granted:

Name @{toUpper(body('Get_item')?['DisplayName_Text'])}
Email @{body('Get_item')?['UserPrincipleName_Text']}
Account Name @{body('Get_Item')?['MailNickname_Text']}
Access Level @{body('Get_item')?['AccessLevel_Text']}
Access Granted By @{toUpper(body('Get_Item')?['Author']?['DisplayName'] )}
Access Granted Date/Time @{formatDateTime( body('Get_item')?['AccessStart_dateTime'], 'MMMM d, yyyy ''at'' h:mmtt' )}
Access Expiration Date/Time @{formatDateTime( body('Get_item')?['AccessStop_dateTime'], 'MMMM d, yyyy ''at'' h:mmtt' )}
App Link: https://make.gov.powerapps.us/environments/Default-e95f1b23-abaf-45ee-821d-b7ab251ab3bf/apps/d0958d55-fe85-425c-83f6-03c659bf4079/details

If you have any questions, concerns, or would like more information about the new advanced access level you have been granted within the '578 EHRM Training App', then please contact the manager/admin who approved your new access (@{body('Get_item')?['Author']?['Email']}). Additional support or instructions are available on the Hines EHRM Deployment SharePoint site: https://dvagov.sharepoint.com/sites/HinesEHRM

Thank you,

Hines EHRM Change Leadership Team

body.Subject: [AUTOMATION FAILURE] A recent access request to the '578 EHRM Training App' has failed due to an automated workflow error!
body.Body:
[ DO NOT REPLY - AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED EMAIL ]


FAILURE! Attention to the AppAdmin's of the 578 EHRM Training App! A new user was recently added to the 578 EHRM Training App's SharePoint list DeskAccessControl, but the automated workflow experienced a failure! See the message below regarding this failure:


Hello @{body('Get_item')?['Author']?['Email']},

You recently attempted to create/modify/remove an advanced level of user access to the '578 EHRM Training App' for the the user: @{toUpper(body('Get_Item')['Email_Text'])}. Unfortunately, the automated workflow process to process the change has failed due to an unexpected error. You can review this automated workflow failure via: Power Automate Run History - 578EHRMTrainingApp_AppUserList.
This failure of this automated workflow is unable to be restarted within the current environment. To resolve, you must investigate & identify the root-cause error that triggered this failure. After that you should delete the erroneous row on relavent SharePoint list, and then add the user over again as a brand new item to the SharePoint list in order to trigger the automated workflow to run with the newly corrected column values.


User's Name: @{toUpper(body('Get_item')?['DisplayName_Text'])}
User's Email: @{body('Get_item')?['UserPrincipleName_Text']}
User's Network Account: @{body('Get_Item')?['MailNickname_Text']}
New Access Level: @{body('Get_item')?['AccessLevel_Text']}
Access Approved By: @{toUpper(body('Get_Item')?['Author']?['DisplayName'] )}
Workflow Failure Date/Time: @{formatDateTime( body('Get_item')?['AccessStart_dateTime'], 'MMMM d, yyyy ''at'' h:mmtt' )}
App Link https://make.gov.powerapps.us/environments/Default-e95f1b23-abaf-45ee-821d-b7ab251ab3bf/apps/d0958d55-fe85-425c-83f6-03c659bf4079/details
AppUserList - SharePoint List @{body('UpdateItem(emailText,_managerProfileDemographics)')?['{Link}']}

If you have any questions, concerns, or would like more information about the '578 EHRM Training App', this Power Automate workflow, or the entire project's centralized data storage resources, then please contact the app developers at: Advanced Clinical Analytics Team. Alternatively, additional support is available on the Clinical Informatics Service's SharePoint site: https://dvagov.sharepoint.com/sites/vhahin/svc/ci .


Thank you,

Hines EHRM Change Leadership Team
